purpose: Single-unit engineering validation of doubly excluded LOSO meta predictions; not a new primary result or a complete gate experiment.
timing: Specified after the existing first-dataset audit and before the first real-data pilot fit; not prospective preregistration of the study.
preprocessing: Read only verified 110-v2 fixed-preprocessing caches. No extraction, normalization change, channel change, or feature selection is performed by this pilot.
inner_selection: Participant LOSO among S03-S15 only; median of inner-fold MLP epochs for the final refit.
model_seed_policy: Inner MLP seed = 1335 + 1009*(fold_index+1); inner RF/ET add 37/74. Final MLP = 1335; final RF/ET add 37/74; stacker = 1335.
stacker_inputs: Base-fold logits within S03-S15 only, with inverse-recording-window weights. No S01 or S02 row enters fit or epoch selection.
target_labels: Fitting APIs accept no S01/S02 labels. S02 labels enter scoring only after all target probabilities are saved. S01 is not loaded for prediction or scoring.
output_aggregation: Single-seed per-class window geometric mean followed by renormalization and argmax; not a five-seed ensemble.
checkpoint_granularity: Completed inner/final model prediction stages; not mid-epoch training continuation.
resume_policy: Reuse only committed checksummed stages with identical protocol, data, source, runtime and membership. Changed or damaged committed evidence stops the run without deleting it.
success_criterion: Isolation, complete aligned normalized predictions and checkpoint integrity, never a required accuracy or gain.

publication_export.path_format: publication-relative paths; workstation executable location omitted
publication_export.presentation_changes: Paths standardized and non-scientific workflow notes removed; scientific values retained.
